title: Pocketwire Rewards Member Pricing on Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Renewals
content:
Members of Pocketwire Rewards pay less on the monthly renewal of their Pocketwire Personal Account plan. The rewards-member reduction on the renewal plan fee is 15 percent for a Pocketwire Rewards membership in active status on the Pocketwire Rewards Diamond or Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian tier, 10 percent for an active membership on the Pocketwire Rewards Gold or Pocketwire Rewards Platinum tier, and 0 percent for any other membership or none.

The reduction is read from the customer's Pocketwire Rewards membership record: its status and its tier.

| Pocketwire Rewards tier | Membership active | Membership in any other status |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 10 percent | 0 percent |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 10 percent | 0 percent |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 15 percent | 0 percent |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 15 percent | 0 percent |
| No membership | 0 percent | — |

**Basis questions**

- *Does a Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian membership that is not active earn the reduction?* No; both conditions — active status and the tier — must hold.
- *Is the reduction the same on the Gold and the Platinum tiers?* Yes, 10 percent on either.
